description: Starter template for the zeos project registry. On install this is copied to ~/.zeos/apps/REGISTRY.json (operator state, outside any repo). Do not edit your fleet here; edit ~/.zeos/apps/REGISTRY.json, or add projects via /newproject. This template ships empty.

architecture.policy: Projects inherit kernel improvements instantly. Velocity over isolation.

schema_docs.name: Human-readable project name
schema_docs.local_path: Path relative to ~/projects/ where this repo lives locally
schema_docs.capabilities: Array of strings describing what this project does
schema_docs.modules: Array of zeos modules this project loads (e.g., 'team')
schema_docs._resolved_paths: As of v1.2.0 operator state lives under the state root (~/.zeos, env ZEOS_STATE_ROOT), resolved by the inject MCP server (path-resolver.ts). Registry at ~/.zeos/apps/REGISTRY.json; profiles at ~/.zeos/profiles/<name>/PROFILE.md; SOUL at ~/.zeos/souls/<app_id>/SOUL.md; MEMORY at ~/.zeos/memory/<app_id>/MEMORY.md; journals at ~/.zeos/journals/<app_id>/; roadmap at ~/.zeos/roadmaps/<app_id>/MASTER_ROADMAP.md. Project CLAUDE.md lives in the project repo at <local_path>/CLAUDE.md.
